C0256.title: Beijing Internet Court Reports on Short-Video Copyright Case Handling
C0256.summary: On April 20, 2022, Beijing Internet Court held a press briefing on short-video copyright cases. The briefing said that from September 9, 2018 to February 28, 2022, the court accepted 2,812 short-video copyright disputes and concluded 2,026. Alleged infringement forms were complex, with clipping and reposting being common. The court also released ten typical cases covering upload of popular songs, background music use, long-video clip editing, subtitle recording of written works, other short-video infringement scenarios, and platform responsibility.
